title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 19.1 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab EE versions from 19.1 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 could allow an authenticated user with developer-role permissions to bypass admin-configured AI tool governance controls in governed namespaces. This occurs due to improper binding of authorization tokens to their intended workflow execution context. The issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
